messages:
sam: Heads-up: noticed sustained provisional > confirmed ratio on eu-central streaming routes after a fallback to cpu-serving yesterday evening. provisional stayed high for ~20m on several sessions.
nina: do we have sample session ids and timeline?
sam: pulled a couple. suspicious pattern where toolcall truncation + router fallback to cpu triggers a confirmed write that doesn't reconcile the provisional ledger entry. pasted trace: 
```
2026-03-21T19:12:03Z route=eu-central session=xyz789 event=stream.start tokens=120 provisional=true
2026-03-21T19:12:10Z route=eu-central session=xyz789 event=toolcall.exec truncated=true reason=backend-reset
2026-03-21T19:12:11Z route=eu-central session=xyz789 event=router.fallback target=cpu-1
2026-03-21T19:12:12Z route=eu-central session=xyz789 event=confirmed_write tokens=120 ledger_id=LDR-987
# provisional never promoted/cleared
```
jorge: Does confirmed_write without handoff.finish imply a bug in the router ack path? should confirm be gated on handoff completion.
lee: I think the CPU fallback path short-circuits and emits a confirmed write as a last-resort so the client isn't charged forever, but we might not be clearing provisional entries that were stored under the original handoff id. we assume an earlier consumer will reconcile, but that might not be guaranteed.
sam: telemetry check i ran (clickhouse):
```
select session, sum(if(event='provisional_alloc', tokens, 0)) as provisional, sum(if(event='confirmed_write', tokens, 0)) as confirmed
from tokens_events
where event_time between now() - interval '1 day' and now()
and route='eu-central'
group by session
having provisional > confirmed*1.5
order by provisional desc
limit 50
```
nina: interesting. many sessions have confirmed ledger entries but provisional rows are still present (older). suggests ledger eviction/compaction never ran for those entries.
jorge: short term mitigation: run a one-off ledger-sweep job that scans for provisional entries older than TTL (e.g., 15m) with matching confirmed writes and mark them reconciled. could be a background job in billing service.
lee: longer term: two fixes: (A) router should emit a canonical reconciliation marker when it does forced confirmed_write during fallback; (B) ledger compact should be idempotent and able to detect and clear orphan provisional by verifying against confirmed ledger index.
ui-squad: console UX: can we add a lightweight column to the billing routes table showing provisional/confirmed delta and a link to sample traces? ops are getting paged for these spikes without context.
sam: yes please. the delta column + quick link to session traces would help debug.
telemetry-bot: queued job: schema-proposal-PR for tokens.sweep_v1. Runs tests on staging.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-02 created: "High provisional delta on eu-central after CPU fallback"
nina: security question: when doing ledger sweep, ensure we preserve customer isolation and don't accidentally reassign credits across customers. the sweep should be per-customer and respect route-scoped keys.
orge: typo -> jorge.
jorge: +1. sweep algorithm sketch: (1) find provisional rows older than TTL per customer/route, (2) query confirmed ledger index for matching session/prefix hash, (3) if confirmed tokens >= provisional tokens, mark provisional reconciled with reason=auto-sweep, emit audit event to ledger-audit topic.
lee: also add metric tokens.sweep.reconciled_count and tokens.sweep.errors. surface failed reconciles to a separate alert so we don't accidentally mask a real leak.
sam: rollout: run sweep in staging, run on a small customer cohort tonight, monitor provisional/confirmed ratio and error rate.
ui-squad: PR #88 opened to add delta column and trace link to Billing->Routes page.
telemetry-bot: CI passed for telemetry changes on staging branch.
ops-bot: Will schedule a 30m maintenance window for the sweep on prod-canary at 21:00 UTC.
sam: thanks all. after sweep completes i'll attach before/after numbers to the incident and we can decide whether to pursue router/ledger fixes next sprint.
